solver: 2D lattice Boltzmann D2Q9 BGK air field; finite-volume smoke
scale: value = 255 * log10(1 + 99*c/scale_max) / 2; rows top to bottom
assumptions: 2D cross-section 4.2 x 2.2 m, 2.0 m deep; rack and vent layout illustrative
No buoyancy (g = 0): smoke moves only with the air and by mixing
Effective viscosity 0.02 m2/s and mixing 0.02 m2/s, inside the range tuned on Saffire-III flight data
Alarm times include a 11 s detector delay tuned on the same record
Screening model, not validated fluid dynamics of a real module
